heygen_avatar_video_2min.purpose: HeyGen avatar creation — Vipul speaks this naturally on camera
heygen_avatar_video_2min.script: Hi everyone! Main Vipul hoon. Aaj main apni life ke sabse exciting announcement karne wala hoon. Mere bade bhai Arpit ka 40th birthday aa raha hai — 23 October ko! Yeh sirf ek birthday nahi hai, yaar. Yeh ek milestone hai. 40 saal! Aur sabse mast baat? Is baar Diwali bhi saath mein aa rahi hai! Toh hum log dono ko ek saath celebrate kar rahe hain — ek double dhamaka! Birthday bhi, Diwali bhi! Lights, music, great food, family, friends — sab kuch ek hi raat mein. Mere bhai ne apni zindagi mein jo kuch bhi achieve kiya hai, jo insaan woh hain, us sab ko is raat celebrate karna chahta hoon. Yeh sirf ek party nahi hai — yeh ek moment hai jo hum sab yaad rakhenge. Toh please, 23 October ko apni diary mein mark kar lo. Aur details ke liye neeche scroll karo. Main personally aapka intezaar karoonga!
